description: This file defines an internal interface ILocalGrainDirectory within the Orleans.Runtime.GrainDirectory namespace. The interface specifies methods and properties for managing local grain directory operations such as starting/stopping the service, lookup, cache invalidation, and management of directory data, primarily used within the Orleans distributed virtual actor framework.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the local portion of the directory service.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the local directory service asynchronously.

methods.name: UnregisterAfterNonexistingActivation
methods.description: Removes the record for a non-existing activation from the directory, used for cleanup.

methods.name: LocalLookup
methods.description: Fetches local directory information for a grain, returning true if data is complete.

methods.name: InvalidateCacheEntry (GrainAddress)
methods.description: Invalidates cache entry for a specific activation address.

methods.name: InvalidateCacheEntry (GrainId)
methods.description: Invalidates cache entry for a specific grain.

methods.name: AddOrUpdateCacheEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates a cache entry for a grain and silo.

methods.name: GetPrimaryForGrain
methods.description: Returns the primary owner silo for a grain, for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetLocalDirectoryData
methods.description: Returns directory info held in local partition for a grain.

methods.name: GetLocalCacheData
methods.description: Returns directory info held in local cache for a grain.

methods.name: TryCachedLookup
methods.description: Attempts to find a grain in the directory cache.

methods.name: IsSiloInCluster
methods.description: Checks if a silo is part of this cluster, used for message forwarding logic.
